integrity: All displayed formulas are derived from the defining polynomial and parametrization. Supporting finite-field computations do not certify the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Specified projective embedding over an algebraically closed field of characteristic two; full projective group of geometric points, Lie dimension and a closed nonreduced subgroup scheme, but not the complete group-scheme structure. The normalization has many automorphisms not induced projectively; historical priority is provisional.
title: The projective-symmetry wall and hidden stabilizers of characteristic-two cuspidal curves
